_doc: Style frame definitions for render_styleframes.py: which cue/offset (s), camera, poses and set-ups. Lighting comes from cue-stack.json.

sf01_first_flicker.caption: Cue 1, 'Just leaving the office now.' P1 mid-flicker, over Walter's shoulder on the 32 mm.

sf02a_brownout.caption: Cue 3, 'I'm at the library, Mum.' Every panel sags to sodium and holds. Master 32 mm.

sf02b_blackout.caption: Cue 4, blackout. True black: panels, windows, display and phones all at zero.

sf02c_lights_up.caption: Cue 4 lights up, same locked wide. Kai's seat is empty and the car is indifferent.

sf03_creeping_dark.caption: Cue 7.7, the creeping dark: P6-P12 out, a hard edge walking up the aisle toward camera.

sf04a_final_relight.caption: Cue 8.10, the last panel (P12) snaps on at its 110% overshoot. The room is whole again.

sf04b_confession_75.caption: Cue 8.3, the confession on the 75 mm: P1 steady and bright, relights spreading out from her.
